title: SalesGen pricing
content: SalesGen costs $99/month for the starter tier, and $299/month for the pro tier. Enterprise pricing is custom.

title: Supported Integrations
content: SalesGen currently supports integrations with Frappe CRM, GitHub, and Calendly.

title: Company Information
content: SalesGen is an AI-powered sales consultant that helps you manage leads and close deals faster.

title: Support hours
content: Our support team is available Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 5 PM EST.
